items.title: Wellman Braud Interview, 1958-03-31
items.q: Amos Nandy was in Raid that time, so Eldon got that title for it, Double Jack Stomp.

ctx.x: What was that other one that you come through? You said, good on Saturday night.

Well, I went, I went, I went, I went, Copenhagen. No, I went Blackpool in 1933. And I was playing on one side of the hall, and it was an English band playing on another, on the other side of the hall. So, he come in and asked me what kind of tuba did I use. So, I said, there's the tuba right up there, son. He couldn't believe it. He thought, yeah, string bass. Yeah, string bass, see. That's right. What about Saturday Night Function or Double Jack Stomp? Oh, I made all that on the screen. Double Jack Stomp, I…
Was that in a movie or something? Did you ever make any movies?
